हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: When bold florist Aarohi unknowingly disrupts the world of ruthless hotel magnate Veer Malhotra, sparks fly between beauty and brutality. As their paths entangle through a twist of fate, business battles give way to buried emotions, painful pasts, and a growing passion neither expected. In a world of power games and fragile dreams, can love truly bloom?
